label: 28 Companion command ack
info: The companion role's inbox. A GCS commands this component (sysid 1 / compid 191) rather than the autopilot; the In node's To sysid / To compid filters admit only COMMAND_LONG / COMMAND_INT addressed here, the function decides, and every such command gets a COMMAND_ACK back so the sender's retry loop stops. MAV_CMD_USER_1 (31010) is accepted; anything else answers UNSUPPORTED (3). Bind 127.0.0.1:14550, remote 14551; signing off for local SITL only. The ack rides the connection's configured remote (14551 here): a ground station's endpoint is never learned (sysids 250–255, §8), so the remote must be the GCS — on a listen-only link the reply has no route.

name: Companion inbox: answer commands addressed to this component
info: In [COMMAND_LONG, COMMAND_INT; To sysid 1, To compid 191] → decide → Out [COMMAND_ACK]. The ack's target_system / target_component are the sender's ids, which mavlink-in put on msg.sysid / msg.compid. This is MAVSDK's command receiver expressed as a flow — the handler table is the wires. The ack rides the connection's configured remote (14551 here): a ground station's endpoint is never learned (sysids 250–255, §8), so the remote must be the GCS — on a listen-only link the reply has no route.

name: decide → COMMAND_ACK
